name: connector-rehearsal-skill
description: Local-first rehearsal planner for connector actions before external writes.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:compiled
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke:compiled
scripts.smoke:compiled: node dist/src/cli.js rehearse fixtures/slack-action.json --format markdown && node dist/src/cli.js diff fixtures/before.json fixtures/after.json
scripts.validate:cli: node dist/src/cli.js plan fixtures/slack-action.json --out tmp/rehearsal && node dist/src/cli.js rehearse fixtures/github-action.json --format json
